'''Graise''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[General/Legends|general]] [[Non-commissioned officer/Legends|non-com]].

==Biography==
When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] learned of a possible [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], Graise was sent to destroy it. He arrived to find the base abandoned, but was promoted to [[General/Legends|general]] for destroying the base nonetheless.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Graise was put in charge of shipping [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] from the Dantooine base to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where they were refitted and shipped offplanet. He also oversaw a Corellian warehouse storing captured starship parts. He was captured by a Rebel agent and interrogated about the project.

==Behind the scenes==
Graise appeared as a non-player character in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
